275:                                      swdra, swhyst, swsnow, sw_end, sw_endtype, sw_endfilter

292: ! --- global
293:       integer, intent(in)  :: task
294: 
295: ! --- local

297:       
298:       integer              :: rw
299:       integer              :: getun

304:       
305:       ! ------------------------------------------------------------------
306: 
307:       select case (task)
308:       
309:       case (1)
310:       
311:          ! set modus
312:          if (fl_initialize) then
313:             ! reading modus
314:             rw = 1
315:          else
316:             ! writing modus
317:             rw = 2
318:          end if
319: 
320:          ! open unit
321:          if (.NOT. unit_opened) then
322:       
323:             ! connection for reading or writing
324:             if (rw == 1) then
325: 
326:                ! open inifile
327:                if (sw_initype == 1) then
328:                   call rdinit(unit_ini, unit_err, inifilnam)
329:                else
330:                   call fopeng (unit_ini, inifilnam, 'old', 'us', 0, ' ')
331:                end if
332: 
333:             end if
334:       
335:             if (rw == 2) then
336: 
337:                ! set filename end-file
338:                if (sw_end == 1 .OR. sw_endtype == 2) then
339:                   filnam = trim(pathwork)//trim(outfil)//'.end'
340:                else
341:                   call dtdpst ('year-month-day',t1900-0.5d0,date)
342:                   filnam = trim(pathwork)//trim(outfil)//'_'//date(1:4)//date(6:7)//date(9:10)//'.end'
343:                end if
344: 
345:                ! open unit
346:                unit_ini = getun (iun_min, iun_max)
347:                if (sw_endtype == 1) then
348:                   call fopeng (unit_ini, filnam, 'new', 'fs', 0, 'del')
349:                else
350:                   call fopeng (unit_ini, filnam, 'new', 'us', 0, 'del')
351:                end if
352: 
353:             end if
354:             
355:             unit_opened = .TRUE.
356:             
357:             ! check type and filter (in case unformatted type)
358:             if (rw == 1 .AND. sw_initype == 2) then
359:                call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_ini, "SWEND")
360:                call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWENDFILTER")
361:                if (sw_value == 1) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'INIFIL incomplete (file contains crop status only)')
362:             end if
363:             
364:             if (rw == 2 .AND. sw_endtype == 2) then
365:                call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_end, "SWEND")
366:                call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_endfilter, "SWENDFILTER")
367:             end if
368:          
369:          end if
370: 
371:          ! check filter before writing end-conditions
372:          rw_status = .TRUE.
373:          if (rw == 2 .AND. sw_endfilter == 1) then
374:             if (fl_cropemergence) then
375:                if (iptra_day - iqrot_day < nihil) then
376:                   rw_status = .FALSE.
377:                end if
378:             end if
379:          end if
380: 
381:          ! read/write end-conditions
382:          if (rw_status) then
383: 
384:             found = .FALSE.
385:             do while (.NOT. found)
386: 
387:                ! check time of end-conditions for initialisation
388:                found = .TRUE.
389:                if (rw == 1 .AND. sw_ini == 2 .AND. sw_initype == 2) then
390:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "TIME")
391:                   if (nint(tstart) /= sw_value) found = .FALSE.
392:                   if (sw_value > nint(tstart)) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'TSTART not found in ini-file')
393:                end if
394:                
395:                ! time of end-conditions
396:                if (rw == 2 .AND. sw_end == 2 .AND. sw_endtype == 2) then
397:                   sw_value = nint(t1900)
398:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "TIME")
399:                end if
400:                
401:                if (.NOT. (rw == 2 .AND. sw_endfilter == 1)) then
402: 
403:                   ! number of compartments
404:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = numnod
405:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "NUMNOD")
406:                   if (numnod /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'DISCRETIZATION inconsistent with ini-file')
407: 
408:                   ! pressure head
409:                   call my_rwadou(unit_ini, rw, h, "H", size(h), numnod)
410: 
411:                   ! ponding layer
412:                   call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, pond, "POND")
413: 
414:                   ! snow layer
415:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = swsnow
416:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWSNOW")
417:                   if (swsnow /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'SWSNOW inconsistent with ini-file')
418:                   if (swsnow == 1) then
419:                      call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, ssnow, "SSNOW")
420:                      call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, slw, "SLW")
421:                   end if
422: 
423:                   ! soil evaporation reservoirs
424:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = swredu
425:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWREDU")
426:                   if (swredu /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'SWREDU inconsistent with ini-file')
427:                   if (swredu == 1) then
428:                      call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, ldwet, "LDWET")
429:                   else if (swredu == 2) then
430:                      call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, spev, "SPEV")
431:                      call my_rwsdou(unit_ini, rw, saev, "SAEV")
432:                   end if
433: 
434:                   ! hysteresis
435:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = swhyst
436:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWHYST")
437:                   if (swhyst /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'SWHYST inconsistent with ini-file')
438:                   if (swhyst /= 0) then
439:                      call my_rwaint(unit_ini, rw, indeks, "INDEKS", size(indeks), numnod)
440:                      call my_rwadou(unit_ini, rw, delp, "DELP", size(delp), numnod)
441:                      call my_rwadou(unit_ini, rw, fhyst, "FHYST", size(fhyst), numnod)
442:                      call my_rwadou(unit_ini, rw, hm1, "HM1", size(hm1), numnod)
443:                   end if
444: 
445:                   ! soil temperatures
446:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = swhea
447:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWHEA")
448:                   if (swhea /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'SWHEA inconsistent with ini-file')
449:                   if (swhea > 0) call my_rwadou(unit_ini, rw, tsoil, "TSOIL", size(tsoil), numnod)
450: 
451:                   ! solute
452:                   if (rw == 2) sw_value = swsolu
453:                   call my_rwsint(unit_ini, rw, sw_value, "SWSOLU")
454:                   if (swsolu /= sw_value) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'SWSOLU inconsistent with ini-file')

458:                   ! surface water

463: 
464:                   ! length of final timestep (d)

466:

471:                end if
472: 
473:                ! crop section
474:                if (fl_cropcalendar) then
475: 
476:                   call my_rwslog(unit_ini, rw, fl_cropcalendar, "FL_CROPCALENDAR")
477:                   if (.NOT. fl_cropcalendar) call swap_error ('read_ini', 'no crop information in ini-file')
478: 
479:                   call my_rwslog(unit_ini, rw, fl_cropemergence, "FL_CROPEMERGENCE")
480:                   call my_rwslog(unit_ini, rw, fl_cropharvest, "FL_CROPHARVEST")
481: 
482:                   if (fl_start_croprotation .AND. rw == 1) then
483: 
484:                      fl_cropemergence = .FALSE.
485:                      fl_cropharvest = .FALSE.
486: 
487:                   else   
488: 
489:                      if (.NOT. fl_cropharvest) then

491:                         call my_rwslog(unit_ini, rw, fl_prep, "FL_PREP")

1280:       ! ------------------------------------------------------------------
1281:       ! Returns meteorological fluxes of current timestep
1282:       ! ------------------------------------------------------------------
1283:       use MOD_params,      only: small
1284:       use plant_interface, only: sw_inter
1285:       use MOD_irrigation,  only: isua, gird, nird
1286: 
1287:       implicit none
1288:       integer, save :: i_rec
1289:       
1290:       ! ------------------------------------------------------------------
1291:      
1292:       ! determine ET-potential
1293:       if (fl_update_meteo) then
1294:         
1295:          fl_update_meteo = .false.
1296:          
1297:          ! update weather record
1298:          i_rec = ((meteo_rec - 1) * n_metdetail) + i_metdetail
1299:          
1300:          ! update weather values in case of detailed meteo
1301:          if (swmetdetail == 1) then
1302:             rad = arad(i_rec)
1303:             tav = atav(i_rec)
1304:             hum = ahum(i_rec)
1305:             win = awin(i_rec)
1306:          end if
1307: 
1308:          call ETpot
1309:      
1310:       end if
1311:      
1312:       ! set precipitation fluxes per time step
1313:       if (swrain == 0) then
1314:         
1315:          if (swmetdetail == 0) then
1316:             graidt = fprecnosnow * grai
1317:          else
1318:             graidt = arai(i_rec) / dt_meteo
1319:          end if    
1320:      
1321:       else
1322:         
1323:          ! set precipitation fluxes for current time step
1324:          graidt = fprecnosnow * rainflx(rain_rec)
1325: 
1326:       end if 
1327:      
1328:       ! interception storage
1329:       if (sw_inter /= 3) then
1330:      
1331:          ! interception based on daily fluxes
1332:          if (swrain == 0) then
1333:             aintcdt = aintc
1334:          else
1335:             if (isua == 0) then
1336:                if (grai + gird > 0.d0) then
1337:                   aintcdt = (graidt + gird) *  aintc / (grai + gird)
1338:                else
1339:                   aintcdt = 0.d0
1340:                end if   
1341:             else
1342:                if (grai > 0.d0) then
1343:                   aintcdt = graidt * aintc / grai
1344:                else
1345:                   aintcdt = 0.d0
1346:                end if   
1347:             end if
1348:          end if    
1349:      
1350:       else
1351:          
1352:          ! calculate interception, method Rutter
1353:          call Rutter ()
1354: 
1355:       end if
1356: 
1357:       ! divide interception into rain part and irrigation part
1358:       ! and calculate net rain and net sprinkling irrigation      
1359:       if (aintcdt < small) then
1360:          nraidt = graidt
1361:          nird = gird
1362:       else
1363:          if (graidt + gird > small) then
1364:             if (isua == 0) then
1365:                nraidt = graidt - aintcdt * (graidt / (graidt + gird))
1366:                nird = gird - aintcdt * (gird / (graidt + gird))
1367:             else
1368:                nraidt = graidt - aintcdt
1369:                nird = gird
1370:             end if
1371:          else
1372:             nraidt = 0.d0
1373:             nird = 0.d0
1374:          end if
1375:       end if
1376:      
1377:       ! soil evaporation rate of current time step
1378:       call reduceva (nraidt)
1379:      
1380:       ! calculate fraction of the day or period the crop is wet
1381:       if (swmetdetail == 0) then
1382:          if (sw_inter == 1 .OR. sw_inter == 2) then
1383:             if (eintc < 0.001d0) then
1384:                wfrac = 0.d0
1385:             else
1386:                wfrac = max(min(aintc / eintc, 1.d0), 0.d0)
1387:             end if
1388:          end if
1389:       end if
1390: 
1391:       ! reduce transpiration and evaporation according to wfrac, the fraction of time that there is interception transpiration
1392:       ptra = wfrac * ptra_wet + (1 - wfrac) * ptra_dry
1393:      
1394:       return

1426:             ew0 = 0.d0
1427:          end if
1428: 
1429:       ! in case reference evapotranspiration must be calculated
1430:       else if (swmetdetail == 1 .OR. swetr == 0) then
1431: 
1432:          ! evapotranspiration using Penman-Monteith: et0, ew0, es0 (mm/d)
1433:          et0 = 0.0d0
1434:          ew0 = 0.0d0
1435:          ep0 = 0.0d0
1436:          es0 = 0.0d0

1446:                   et0 = et0 * cf

1452:                ew0 = 0.0d0
1453:             end if
1454: 
1455:          end if
1456:

1460:       epond = max(0.d0, ep0 * 0.1d0)
1461:

1502:       implicit none

1514:          ! force zero evaporation
1515:          peva = 0.0d0
1516:          empreva = 0.0d0
1517: 
1518:       else   
1519:       
1520:          ! reduction potential soil evaporation for every time step
1521:          if (pond > 1.0d-10) then
1522:          
1523:             ! in case of ponding no reduction
1524:             empreva = epond
1525:             ldwet = 0.0d0
1526:             spev = 0.0d0
1527:             saev = 0.0d0
1528:       
1529:          else if (swredu == 1) then
1530:       
1531:             ! reduction with black model
1532:             if (nrai+nird > rsigni) ldwet = 0.0d0
1533:             empreva = (cofred * (dsqrt(ldwet + dt) - dsqrt(ldwet))) / dt
1534:             empreva = min(empreva, peva)
1535:             ldwet = ldwet + dt
1536:       
1537:          else if (swredu == 2) then
1538: 
1539:             ! reduction with boesten and stroosnijder model
1540:             if ((nrai + nird) < peva) then
1541:                spev = spev + (peva - (nrai + nird)) * dt
1542:                saevm1 = saev
1543:                if (spev < cofred**2) then
1544:                  saev = spev
1545:                else
1546:                  saev = cofred * dsqrt(spev)
1547:                end if
1548:                empreva = nrai + nird + (saev - saevm1) / dt
1549:             else
1550:                empreva = peva
1551:                saev = max (0.0d0, saev - (nrai + nird - peva) * dt)

1553:                  spev = saev
1554:                else
1555:                  spev = (saev / cofred)**2
1556:                end if
1557:             end if
1558:          end if
1559:          
1560:       end if
1561: 
1562:       return
